newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bomb kills two, injures dozens in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills two, injures dozens in Colombia.

text.p: Two people were killed and dozens were injured when a bomb exploded on Tuesday in the centre of Monteria, the main town in Colombia's northwest Cordoba province, police said.
The blast occurred about 3:15 p.m. (2015 GMT). Police were unable to give further details about the bomb.
The explosion followed a powerful car bomb blast that rocked a residential district of the city of Medellin on Monday, killing a woman and injuring at least 48 other people.
In Monteria on Oct. 21, a bomb consisting of 88 pounds (40 kg) of dynamite, hidden in a street vendor's cart, exploded outside the town's police headquarters, injuring 10 people.

That attack was blamed on the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), Colombia's oldest and largest guerrilla army. The intended target was a private foundation that helps former guerrillas who have laid down their arms to return to civilian life.
Officials said Tuesday they believed Monday's bomb blast in Medellin was caused by drug traffickers in league with guerrillas.
